notes.itemTitle: Submit the visa application at TLS Contact
notes.title: Delhi email has gone
notes.text: You wrote to Campus France New Delhi this morning and copied Fitria, so the transfer now waits on Delhi. Your email says you fly to India on 4 November and will apply through New Delhi VFS, so Friday's TLS date here is dead. - Give it a date you expect to use, or clear it until Delhi answers.

notes.itemTitle: Close the KITAS and withdraw BPJS
notes.title: InCorp wants your answer
notes.text: Chitra wrote this morning asking whether you are renewing or cancelling the KITAS, and the revised quotation for cancellation, NPWP and BPJS is still unanswered. She notes renewal normally starts a month before the 8 November expiry, so that window has closed. - Tell her you are cancelling, since you leave on the 4th.
